What types of events do you perform at?: We perform at weddings, civil ceremonies, corporate events, private parties, and concerts in Cardiff, London, Bristol, and across the UK.
How much does a wedding string quartet c: Our prices start from £500, but every event is different. We provide bespoke quotes based on location, date, and booking length. Get in touch for a tailored quote—most clients hear back within a few hours.
How do I book Serenade Strings?: Just send us a message via our contact form or call us directly. Tell us about your event, and we’ll send you a clear quote. Once you’re happy, we’ll confirm your booking and handle the rest.
Are you insured?: Yes, all our musicians have full public liability insurance (PLI) through the Musicians’ Union. Certificates are available on request.
Can you play my favourite song or take r: Absolutely! We love learning new music and include special requests with every booking.
Will you play outside at my wedding or e: Yes, we’re happy to perform outdoors, weather permitting. We always recommend having a backup indoor option just in case.
How do I pay for my booking?: Payment is usually made by bank transfer. We’ll send you all the details along with your contract.
Can I choose the music for my event?: Yes! We work closely with you to create a playlist that matches your style and the atmosphere you want.
What happens if one of your musicians is: We have a pool of highly skilled musicians. In the rare event of illness or emergency, we guarantee a professional replacement so your event goes ahead smoothly.
Do you require a deposit?: Yes, we usually ask for a deposit to secure your date. The balance is due closer to your event.
How far in advance should I book?: We recommend booking as early as possible, especially for peak wedding dates. Some clients book over a year in advance, but we’re always happy to check last-minute availability.
